title: Pot Hole - Routine Repair
description: Use this service request to report routine pothole repairs. A routine pothole is a hole in the pavement that is 3 feet by 3 feet in diameter or less. Please indicate where the pothole is located - in the street or alley. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

conditionalPaths.instruction: If this is concerning a hazardous condition please call 3-1-1 for immediate assistance.
The Drive Approach is the Owner's Responsibility to repair.

observedQuestions.question: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Hazardous = No; location = Street; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a routine pothole in a street or alley.
actions.why: For a nonhazardous pavement hole no larger than about three feet by three feet in a street or alley. The 311 request form asks whether it is hazardous and where it is located.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Pot Hole - Routine Repair" requests is not the directed route for a hazardous pothole or a driveway approach that the owner is responsible for repairing. If the pothole is hazardous, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Pot Hole - Routine Repair"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Pot Hole - Routine Repair"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a hazardous pothole.
actions.why: For a pothole that may cause serious vehicle damage or pedestrian injury. The Pot Hole - Routine Repair request form directs people who answer Yes to its hazardous question to call 311 for immediate assistance.
